copy.tagline: 集成 WhatsApp 云 API 到你的应用

copy.tagline_en: Integrate WhatsApp Cloud API into your app

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会把WhatsApp Cloud适配器从channels分支复制进项目、注册到渠道列表，并安装固定版本依赖包，然后运行构建和测试。完成后程序就能通过Meta官方API收发一对一私聊消息。
howto.when: 当你说“添加WhatsApp Cloud渠道”、“接入WhatsApp官方API”等要求，或正在执行/setup流程需要连接WhatsApp时，这个技能会接管并开始配置。

say.text: 帮我的项目添加WhatsApp Cloud渠道，用官方API
say.note: Claude会复制适配器、注册并安装依赖，然后验证构建。

say.text: 我要连接WhatsApp，接收客户私聊消息
say.note: Claude会执行本技能，完成渠道配置。
如果正在设置流程中，Claude会按步骤接入。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude copies the WhatsApp Cloud adapter from the channels branch into the project, registers it in the channel barrel, installs the pinned dependency, then runs build and tests. Your app can then send and receive 1:1 messages via Meta's official WhatsApp Cloud API.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add a WhatsApp Cloud channel, connect the official WhatsApp API, or while running the /setup flow and need to set up WhatsApp.

say_en.text: Add the WhatsApp Cloud channel to my project using the official API
say_en.note: Claude copies the adapter, registers it, installs deps, and runs checks.

say_en.text: I want to receive private messages from WhatsApp
say_en.note: Claude runs this skill to configure the WhatsApp channel.
Claude completes the channel setup as part of the flow.
